theme.description: A highly readable, playful, and tactile aesthetic focusing on the 'food and nutrition' theme. Avoids generic SaaS looks by leaning into organic shapes, bouncy typography, and warm, appetite-inducing colors.

typography.instructions: Use Fredoka for all headings to establish a friendly, bouncy, playful vibe. Use Nunito for body text for supreme readability while maintaining soft, rounded characteristics. Ensure these fonts are imported from Google Fonts in index.css.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-none font-semibold

marketing_page.hero: Asymmetrical layout with overlapping image elements and high negative space. Never use generic centered text.

dashboard.spacing: Tight (gap-6) but generous internal card padding (p-6 or p-8)

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Active states must have slight scale down (active:scale-95). High contrast text.
components.cards: Neumorphic/Tactile variant. Soft ambient shadow + 1px subtle border. No pure flat cards without border.
components.inputs: Use Shadcn inputs but override to rounded-2xl, border-slate-200, focus:ring-2 focus:ring-orange-500/20.
components.chat_bubbles: For meal input, use distinct colored bubbles (User: bg-orange-500 text-white, AI: bg-slate-100 text-slate-900). Must be rounded-3xl with one sharper corner depending on message orientation.

motion.hover: Subtle y-axis lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow increase for interactive cards.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up for dashboard widgets and meal history items.

icons.style: Stroke width 2.5 for a slightly bolder, playful look.

image_urls.description: Vibrant close-up of a fresh vegetable salad.
Woman eating healthy food, perfect for landing page testimonials or feature section.
Fresh strawberry in a glass, useful for hydration or snack suggestions.

media.treatment: Images must have rounded-3xl or rounded-full (for avatars/icons) to match the playful aesthetic. Never use harsh square corners on images.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text on colored backgrounds meets APCA guidelines. Tangerine (#f97316) button must use white text. Mint green accents should use dark text.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have focus-visible ring.
accessibility.testing: MANDATORY: Add data-testid to all buttons, links, inputs, and major UI sections. Convention: kebab-case, role-based.

instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT use generic centered text for the marketing page. Use asymmetrical layouts (e.g., text left, playful overlapping food images on right).
Use Shadcn UI for forms, dropdowns, dialogs, but OVERRIDE border-radius to large values (rounded-2xl/rounded-3xl) to fit the playful theme.
For the daily nutrition dashboard, use Recharts (or Shadcn Charts) with custom soft colors matching the theme (Orange for Protein, Emerald for Fiber, Yellow for Carbs, etc.).
The chat interface for logging meals should feel like messaging a friendly nutritionist, not a terminal.
Implement a visible navigation bar on all pages. For the dashboard, a collapsible sidebar or clean top nav works best. Ensure header is NOT fully transparent over content.
Ensure all components are in .js/.jsx files as this is a JavaScript project (not TypeScript).
Use text-only chat-like input for meals that generates an AI-powered breakdown.
Create a daily summary dashboard for setting goals and showing AI meal suggestions based on remaining targets.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky headers.
DO NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
DO NOT center align the app container, i.e. do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute for robust automated testing.
